lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, forming a distinct lattice-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal aspect and low-luminance shadows below.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high density of small, lower-contrast spots that are significantly smaller in diameter compared to the primary lateral flank blobs.
